text:
alyssa: saw a small spike in invoice PREVIEW for a handful of tenants at ~03:12 UTC. customers see doubled preview rows, final invoices look fine but support is noisy.

sam: traced it. ingest emits provisional metering with epoch=null, then joiner commits epoch a bit later. preview pipeline surfaces both until dedupe runs. sample logs:
INFO 2026-03-22T03:12:01Z ingest req=ri_ab1 epoch=null route=embed-heavy tokens=80
INFO 2026-03-22T03:12:02Z joiner req=ri_ab1 epoch=epoch-20260322-03 tokens=80

mira: UX mitigation idea: collapse duplicate preview rows in console when a matching final commit appears within 5m. show a small "provisional" badge and allow expansion to view raw items for audits. low risk and reversible.
jordan: infra approach: create a shadow-preview stream and a Redis/Lua dedupe store. Edge can optionally pause X ms for epoch assignment per route (feature flag) to reduce provisional emits. Shadow preview lets us test without affecting users.
sam: also propose standardizing x-client-request-id in SDKs so retries don't generate new request_ids that defeat dedupe. add telemetry counters: metering.preview_duplicates, metering.provisional_emitted, metering.provisional_wait_ms.
ops-bot: INC-4821 alerts muted for affected tenant cohort while we triage.

alyssa: owners: mira -> console collapse + modal copy; sam -> edge change + SDK header + telemetry; jordan -> shadow preview + dedupe store + e2e tests. timeline: UI quick fix today, feature-flag infra change in ~48h, canary 5% -> ramp over 7d. ops to hold alerts during canary. reconvene 11:00 PT with PRs.

eng-telemetry-bot: auto-created dashboards: metering/preview-duplicates and metering/provisional-latency (viewers: eng-platform,billing).

mira: will post modal mock + PR link shortly.
sam: will open edge PR behind feature flag.
jordan: adding e2e that simulates late-join ordering and retry id churn.

alyssa: thanks all — tag me with any new preview spikes and paste the raw log line. :thumbsup:
